purpose: extend H5 quarterly WFO, constrain probabilities, H1 external context, genuine daily prospective records
neural_recipe: v2 H5 MSE 5-year, same 3 seeds and natural 20 epochs; all old fits reused with hashes

slow.purge: train target endpoints strictly before first validation anchor
slow.gate: validation Brier improves >1e-12, number correct does not fall, no refit after validation
slow.platt: same v2 unconstrained logit slope/intercept ridge .01
slow.shrink: q=training-bank up frequency; p_new=q+alpha*(p-q), alpha clipped to [0,1], train Brier minimizer; no ranking inversion
slow.calibration_bank: each cadence and method uses its own causal OOS probabilities; never borrow annual bank for quarterly model
slow.old_interactions: keep additive, vol, joint-order and fixed-parent-order; no post-result head selection

fast.matching: identical eligible training members and test dates for context comparisons; full-own-history diagnostic retained
fast.inference: same-day close or older only; no present constituent backcast
fast.secondary: descriptive; no neural architecture search or selection from test results

live.mode: manual daily after close, genuine same-date records only
live.labels: H1 and H5 close to close, calendar positions, no fills claimed
live.fixed_evaluation: no retrospective inserts, append-only hash chained events, overlapping H5 samples flagged
live.parameter_expiry: 2026-09-30; block October predictions until a separately verified new parameter package exists
live.split_action_guard: compare reconstructed forward-adjusted closes to vendor hfq; unknown corporate actions block
live.no_promotion: prospective candidate family fixed before viewing new results

history: all historical dates have already been examined: exploratory, not independent confirmation
exclusions: no orders, account access, or modification of index app/ledger
no HMM/DTW/pretrained or unbounded parameter search
